prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: hit while turning left. Injury: wrist fracture. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1233; do not mention it.)
text:
Our firm represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was lawfully turning left at an intersection when your insured's vehicle struck the driver's side of our client's car. The police report and the physical damage to both vehicles support our client's account that the collision was caused by your insured's failure to yield the right of way.

As a direct result of the impact, [CLIENT_NAME] suffered a fracture of the wrist that required emergency treatment, immobilization, and ongoing orthopedic care. Our client has missed substantial time from work, has been restricted in daily activities, and continues to experience pain, stiffness, and reduced grip strength. Medical records and billing statements documenting this treatment are enclosed.

Liability in this matter is clear, and the damages are well documented. We therefore demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve all claims arising from this accident against your insured. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we are authorized to file a civil action without further notice and to seek all damages available under the law, including costs and interest.

Please direct all further communications regarding this matter to our office.
